description: Land Acquisition - Kadatkaraichenai, Muthur D/S Division, Trincomalee District - Dewaladeniya Laggala D/S Division, Matale District
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels, their boundaries, extents, and locations, along with orders for taking possession of these lands. While it mentions a government minister (Nalaka Jude Harin Fernando), the core content focuses exclusively on land-related administrative actions rather than government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities. The document is explicitly labeled as "PART III - LANDS" and "Land Acquisition Notices," confirming its land-focused nature.
